Reflection: Coding CV using Markdown

Situation

As part of the digital portfolio assignment, I was required to create and present my CV using Markdown on GitHub. This was a new experience for me as I had not previously used Markdown to structure professional documents.

Task

My task was to convert a traditional CV into a well-structured digital format using Markdown syntax while ensuring that the information remained clear, professional, and easy to read.

Action

To complete this task, I researched how Markdown works and learned how to use headings, bullet points, and formatting techniques to organise my content.And i also made use of the student guide as it showcases how tackle the markdown. I carefully structured my CV into sections such as personal information, skills, and education. I ensured consistency in formatting and focused on readability so that anyone viewing the CV could easily understand my qualifications and abilities.

Result

As a result, I successfully created a clean, well-organised digital CV that is accessible online. This process improved my technical skills in Markdown and enhanced my ability to present information professionally in a digital format.

Reflection: Mock Interview

Situation

During the work readiness training, I participated in a mock interview designed to simulate a real job interview environment. This activity aimed to prepare me for future employment opportunities.

Task

My responsibility was to answer interview questions confidently, communicate clearly, and demonstrate professionalism throughout the interview process.

Action

To prepare, I practiced answering common interview questions and focused on improving my communication skills. During the interview, I maintained eye contact, spoke clearly, and structured my answers thoughtfully. I also ensured that I remained calm and confident, even when responding to challenging questions.

Result

The mock interview helped me build confidence and improve my communication skills. I gained a better understanding of how to present myself professionally and respond effectively to interview questions. This experience has prepared me for real-world interviews and highlighted areas where I can continue to improve.

Reflection: GitHub Pages

Situation

As part of the assignment, I was required to publish my digital portfolio using GitHub Pages, transforming my repository into a live website.

Task

My task was to configure GitHub Pages correctly and ensure that my portfolio content was properly structured and displayed online.

Action

I navigated the GitHub settings to enable GitHub Pages and selected the appropriate branch for deployment. I ensured that my README file was well-formatted using Markdown so that it would display correctly as a webpage. I also tested the published link to confirm that all content was visible and accessible.

Result

I successfully published my portfolio as a live website, making it accessible to others through a public link. This experience improved my understanding of web deployment and gave me practical knowledge of how to present my work professionally online.
